name: @cnvlabskoxyz/celina-mcp

tools.name: get_network_status
tools.description: Returns Celo mainnet chain ID, latest block, and gas price.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Fetch a Celo mainnet block by number, hash, or latest.

tools.name: get_latest_blocks
tools.description: Fetch the most recent blocks on Celo mainnet.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Fetch a transaction and receipt by hash on Celo mainnet.

tools.name: verify_attribution_tag
tools.description: Decode ERC-8021 (celina, app codes) attribution from a Celo mainnet tx calldata. Optionally pass tag to check for a specific code.

tag.description: Optional attribution code to match (e.g. celo_862c21dd97a7, MY_APP). Omit to decode all tags.

tools.name: check_attribution_tag
tools.description: List all ERC-8021 attribution tags on a Celo mainnet transaction in lowercase (same as erc8021.codes), or check whether a specific tag is present. Prefer this for "what tags are on this tx?"; use verify_attribution_tag for the raw layer.

tag.description: Optional attribution code to match (e.g. celo_862c21dd97a7, MY_APP). Omit to list all tags.

tools.name: get_wallet_address
tools.description: Returns the MCP server wallet address(es). Omit signer to get the default signer's address plus every configured wallet (celo, self_agent) — use this to find the Self agent's address before funding it. Pass signer to look up one wallet specifically.

signer.description: MCP server signer: celo (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY) or self_agent (SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). Defaults to the CELO wallet when both keys are configured.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns native CELO balance, nonce, and whether the address is a contract.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: get_celo_account_registration
tools.description: Whether an address is registered in the Celo Accounts contract (required before locking CELO).

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: execute_register_celo_account
tools.description: Register a configured MCP server wallet as a Celo account (Accounts.createAccount). Pass signer to choose which wallet (celo = main, self_agent = Self identity) gets registered — required before that same wallet can lock CELO or stake.

signer.description: MCP server signer: celo (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY) or self_agent (SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). Defaults to the CELO wallet when both keys are configured.

tools.name: get_celo_balances
tools.description: Balances for named registry tokens on Celo mainnet. Default tokens: CELO + USDm. Reads on-chain balances for the given address only; GoodDollar connected-wallet identity is not resolved.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

items.description: Celo mainnet token symbol (e.g. CELO, USDm, USDC, USDT, USAT)

tools.name: get_stablecoin_balances
tools.description: Scan fiat-pegged registry stablecoins (Mento *m, USDT, USDC, USAT, etc.) for an address in one call. Omits zero balances by default. Excludes GoodDollar (G$) and WETH — use get_token_balance or GoodDollar tools for those. Reads on-chain balances for the given address only; GoodDollar connected-wallet identity is not resolved.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: get_token_info
tools.description: Registry token metadata (symbol, address, decimals). Does not read balances.

token.description: Celo mainnet token symbol (e.g. CELO, USDm, USDC, USDT, USAT)

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Balance for one registry token. Pass a symbol or known registry contract address. Reads on-chain balances for the given address only; GoodDollar connected-wallet identity is not resolved.

token.description: Celo mainnet token symbol (e.g. CELO, USDm, USDC, USDT, USAT)

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: estimate_send
tools.description: Estimates gas for sending CELO or an ERC-20. Recipient can be ENS. On MCP, pass signer to estimate from a specific configured wallet (celo or self_agent) — e.g. before funding a Self agent from the main wallet.

to.description: Recipient 0x address or ENS name (e.g. andrewkimjoseph.celo.eth, celina.eth)

token.description: Celo mainnet token symbol (e.g. CELO, USDm, USDC, USDT, USAT)

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

signer.description: MCP server signer: celo (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY) or self_agent (SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). Defaults to the CELO wallet when both keys are configured.

tools.name: send_token
tools.description: Send CELO or an ERC-20 on mainnet. Requires CELO_PRIVATE_KEY or SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY in MCP server env. Pass signer to choose which configured wallet sends — e.g. signer: "celo" to fund a freshly registered Self agent with CELO before any Self-signed write (lock, stake, vote, register_celo_account).

to.description: Recipient 0x address or ENS name (e.g. andrewkimjoseph.celo.eth, celina.eth)

token.description: Celo mainnet token symbol (e.g. CELO, USDm, USDC, USDT, USAT)

signer.description: MCP server signer: celo (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY) or self_agent (SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). Defaults to the CELO wallet when both keys are configured.

tools.name: get_gas_fee_data
tools.description: Returns current gas fee data including EIP-1559 fees on mainnet.

tools.name: estimate_transaction
tools.description: Estimates gas for a generic transaction (to/value/data) from a wallet.

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: get_mento_swap_pairs
tools.description: List tradable Mento FX registry-token pairs on Celo mainnet. Call this before listing Mento pairs — do not invent them.

token.description: Optional registry token. When set, only pairs involving this token are returned.

tools.name: get_mento_fx_quote
tools.description: Mento FX oracle quote for a token pair on mainnet. Read-only.

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: estimate_mento_fx
tools.description: Estimate gas for a Mento FX conversion including approval if needed.

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

recipient.description: Address that receives output tokens (defaults to signer)

tools.name: execute_mento_fx
tools.description: Execute a Mento FX conversion on mainnet. Requires CELO_PRIVATE_KEY.

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

recipient.description: Address that receives output tokens (defaults to signer)

tools.name: get_uniswap_swap_pairs
tools.description: List Uniswap v3 and v4 registry-token pairs on Celo mainnet. Each pair includes venues. v3 covers hub-token pools only. Call this before listing Uniswap pairs — do not invent them.

token.description: Optional registry token. When set, only pairs involving this token are returned.

tools.name: get_uniswap_quote
tools.description: Uniswap AMM quote for a token pair on Celo mainnet. Compares v3 and v4 and returns the higher output. protocol is uniswap_v3 or uniswap_v4.

token_in.description: Celo mainnet token symbol (e.g. CELO, USDm, USDC, USDT, USAT)

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: estimate_uniswap_swap
tools.description: Estimate gas for the better Uniswap v3 or v4 swap. v4 includes ERC-20 and Permit2 approvals when needed. v3 includes one ERC-20 approval to SwapRouter02 when needed.

token_in.description: Celo mainnet token symbol (e.g. CELO, USDm, USDC, USDT, USAT)

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: execute_uniswap_swap
tools.description: Execute the better Uniswap v3 or v4 swap on Celo mainnet. Requires CELO_PRIVATE_KEY. v3 uses SwapRouter02. v4 uses Universal Router and Permit2.

token_in.description: Celo mainnet token symbol (e.g. CELO, USDm, USDC, USDT, USAT)

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: get_aave_balances
tools.description: Read supplied Aave V3 balances (aToken holdings) on Celo in underlying token units including accrued interest. Each balance has formatted (human-readable, e.g. "0.000002") and raw (atomic units — do not quote raw to users). Supported: USDT, WETH, USDm, USDC, CELO, EURm. Omit address to use the session wallet when CELO_PRIVATE_KEY is set.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

items.description: Aave asset symbol on Celo (USDT, WETH, USDm, USDC, CELO, EURm). Pass the symbol only.

tools.name: supply_aave
tools.description: Supply tokens to Aave V3 on Celo. Supported: USDT, WETH, USDm, USDC, CELO, EURm. Requires CELO_PRIVATE_KEY.

token.description: Aave asset symbol on Celo (USDT, WETH, USDm, USDC, CELO, EURm). Pass the symbol only.

tools.name: withdraw_aave
tools.description: Withdraw tokens from Aave V3 on Celo. Supported: USDT, WETH, USDm, USDC, CELO, EURm. Requires CELO_PRIVATE_KEY.

token.description: Aave asset symbol on Celo (USDT, WETH, USDm, USDC, CELO, EURm). Pass the symbol only.

tools.name: resolve_ens
tools.description: Resolve a Celo or Ethereum ENS name to an address. Defaults to Celo coin record with Ethereum fallback.

name.description: ENS name, e.g. celina.eth or andrewkimjoseph.celo.eth

tools.name: get_gooddollar_whitelisting_info
tools.description: Check GoodDollar IdentityV4 whitelist status for a wallet. Connected wallets resolve to their verified root; returns isWhitelisted, isWhitelistedRoot, whitelistedRoot, and checkedAddress.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: get_gooddollar_identity_link
tools.description: How a wallet links to GoodDollar IdentityV4: whitelisted root, whether the address is itself the root (isWhitelistedRoot), connected-to root, and live whitelist status.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: get_gooddollar_ubi_entitlement
tools.description: Daily GoodDollar UBI claim eligibility: whitelist root, claimable G$, already claimed. isWhitelistedRoot is true when the queried address is the identity root. Nested identity.isWhitelisted and identity.isWhitelistedRoot reflect the resolved root.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: claim_daily_gooddollar_ubi
tools.description: Claim today's GoodDollar UBI for the MCP server wallet. Requires CELO_PRIVATE_KEY.

tools.name: get_gooddollar_reserve_quote
tools.description: GoodDollar reserve quote for G$ ↔ USDm on Celo (MentoBroker bonding curve). Use amount_side "out" when the user names the amount they want to receive (e.g. "get 0.6 USDm"). Uses the literal signing wallet address for balances; does not resolve GoodDollar identity roots.

amount.description: Human-readable amount; paired with amount_side (in = spend, out = receive)

amount_side.description: 'in': amount is token_in spend (default). 'out': amount is desired token_out receive amount.

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: estimate_gooddollar_reserve_swap
tools.description: Estimate gas for a GoodDollar reserve swap (G$ ↔ USDm), including ERC-20 approval when needed. Uses the literal signing wallet address for balances; does not resolve GoodDollar identity roots.

amount.description: Human-readable amount; paired with amount_side (in = spend, out = receive)

amount_side.description: 'in': amount is token_in spend (default). 'out': amount is desired token_out receive amount.

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: execute_gooddollar_reserve_swap
tools.description: Execute a GoodDollar reserve swap (G$ ↔ USDm) on mainnet. Requires CELO_PRIVATE_KEY.

amount.description: Human-readable amount; paired with amount_side (in = spend, out = receive)

amount_side.description: 'in': amount is token_in spend (default). 'out': amount is desired token_out receive amount.

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: get_gooddollar_face_verification_link
tools.description: Generate a GoodDollar face verification link for the MCP server wallet (first-time verify this wallet as an identity root). Skipped when the signer is already whitelisted or linked to a verified root. Requires a signing key. Link generation is implemented in celina-sdk; MCP forwards configured viem clients.

callback_url.description: URL to redirect after verification; defaults to Celina callback page

tools.name: execute_connect_gooddollar_identity
tools.description: Connect a secondary wallet to the whitelisted GoodDollar identity root. The MCP signer (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY or SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY) must be the verified whitelisted root; pass the wallet to link as connected_account. If already verified on a different wallet, switch the signing key to that verified root first.

signer.description: MCP server signer: celo (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY) or self_agent (SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). Defaults to the CELO wallet when both keys are configured.

tools.name: execute_disconnect_gooddollar_identity
tools.description: Disconnect a secondary wallet from a GoodDollar identity.

signer.description: MCP server signer: celo (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY) or self_agent (SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). Defaults to the CELO wallet when both keys are configured.

tools.name: get_governance_proposals
tools.description: Returns Celo governance proposals with pagination. Set include_metadata=false for faster responses.

tools.name: get_proposal_details
tools.description: Returns detailed information about a Celo governance proposal.

tools.name: get_locked_celo_balance
tools.description: Locked CELO balances and governance voting power for an address.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: get_pending_withdrawals
tools.description: Pending LockedGold withdrawals with maturity timestamps for an address.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: get_votable_proposals

tools.name: get_actionable_governance_proposals
tools.description: Queued and Referendum proposals you can act on now (upvote or vote). When dequeueReady, queued items may have upvoteable=false — call execute_dequeue_proposals_if_ready first. Use get_proposal_details on a proposal_id before governing.

tools.name: get_governance_votes
tools.description: Referendum votes and queue upvotes cast by an address on Celo governance.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.description: Lock CELO for governance and staking. Requires humanness verification and a registered Celo account.

tools.description: Relock CELO from a pending withdrawal index. Requires humanness verification.

tools.description: Vote on a governance proposal in Referendum. Vote values: Abstain, No, Yes.

signer.description: MCP server signer: celo (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY) or self_agent (SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). Defaults to the CELO wallet when both keys are configured.

signer.description: MCP server signer: celo (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY) or self_agent (SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). Defaults to the CELO wallet when both keys are configured.

signer.description: MCP server signer: celo (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY) or self_agent (SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). Defaults to the CELO wallet when both keys are configured.

tools.name: execute_revoke_governance_votes
tools.description: Revoke all active referendum governance votes for the signer in one transaction (bulk on-chain).

signer.description: MCP server signer: celo (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY) or self_agent (SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). Defaults to the CELO wallet when both keys are configured.

tools.description: Revoke the signer's active queue upvote on a Queued governance proposal.

tools.description: Governance vote delegation info from LockedGold for an address.

Then call execute_delegate_power with a chosen delegatee address.

tools.description: Look up a governance delegate by address — Celo Mondo profile (if listed) plus on-chain LockedGold stats.

tools.description: NFT balance for an address. Token ID required for ERC-1155.

address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

abi.description: Contract ABI as a JSON array

from_address.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

tools.name: estimate_contract_gas
tools.description: Estimates gas for a contract function call. Requires caller-supplied ABI JSON. Call before execute_contract_function when possible.

abi.description: Contract ABI as a JSON array

from.description: Wallet on Celo mainnet. Omit to use the connected wallet or the configured MCP signer (CELO or Self agent).

abi.description: Contract ABI as a JSON array

tools.name: verify_self_agent
tools.description: Verify whether an agent address is backed by a real human on Self Agent ID (Celo mainnet). Defaults to requiring age 18+ and OFAC-clear credentials; pass require_age: 0 or require_ofac: false to relax.

tools.name: lookup_self_agent
tools.description: Look up a Self Agent ID by numeric on-chain ID. Returns credentials with ofac_clear (all OFAC checks passed) and ofac_checks — a labeled array where clear: true means not on that sanctions list.

tools.name: verify_self_request
tools.description: Verify incoming HTTP request headers signed by a Self Agent (not file system access).

request_path.description: HTTP request path or URL path+query that was signed — not a filesystem path.

tools.name: register_self_agent
tools.description: Start Self Agent ID registration. Returns qr_code_url and deep_link — present BOTH to the user. Default mode: wallet-free — omit mode for a standalone agent wallet. Use linked only when binding to a human's existing wallet (pass human_address). Defaults to minimum_age 18, nationality disclosure, and OFAC screening (Self agents must not be tied to OFAC-listed humans). Pass minimum_age: 0, nationality: false, or ofac: false to opt out.

mode.description: Registration mode. Default wallet-free when omitted. Use linked only with human_address to tie the agent to an existing human wallet.

tools.name: check_self_registration
tools.description: Poll a pending Self registration, proof refresh, or deregistration session.

tools.name: get_self_identity
tools.description: Return a Self Agent ID identity. Pass agent_address to read any wallet on-chain without a key; omit it in a wallet chat to use the connected wallet. With no agent_address and a configured SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, returns that server agent's identity.

agent_address.description: Agent address to look up on-chain. Omit to use the connected wallet, or the configured Self agent key when an MCP executor is present.

tools.name: refresh_self_proof
tools.description: Start a human proof refresh after on-chain proof expiry. Returns qr_code_url and deep_link.

tools.name: deregister_self_agent
tools.description: Start irreversible Self agent deregistration. Returns qr_code_url and deep_link.

tools.name: sign_self_request
tools.description: Sign an HTTP request with the configured Self agent. Demo verify: POST https://app.ai.self.xyz/api/demo/verify?network=celo-mainnet

tools.name: authenticated_self_fetch
tools.description: HTTP request with Self Agent ID auth headers. Demo: ?network=celo-mainnet — https://app.ai.self.xyz/api/demo/verify?network=celo-mainnet

tools.name: get_agentkarma_reputation
tools.description: Read AgentKarma Provider + Consumer reputation for a Celo agent wallet (read-only, agentkarma.io). Optional trust context — never routes, signs, or holds custody.

address.description: Celo 0x address of the agent/counterparty to look up.

face.description: Karma face to read: provider, consumer, or both (default).

tools.name: get_agentkarma_celo_agent
tools.description: Resolve a Celo ERC-8004 agent (identity + reputation) by numeric agent ID via AgentKarma (read-only).

tools.name: check_agentkarma_counterparty
tools.description: Evaluate a Celo counterparty against a local AgentKarma trust policy (min score, receipt-backed). Returns an explainable allow/deny decision plus the snapshot it read. Read-only — never routes, signs, or holds custody.

address.description: Celo 0x address of the agent/counterparty to look up.

face.description: Face to score the decision on (default provider).

min_score.description: Reject when the face score is below this (0–100).

require_receipt_backed.description: Require at least one Tier-1 receipt-backed signal on the face.

instructions:
You are connected to Celina, the Celo MCP server (mainnet only).

Guidelines:
- Prefer read-only tools (get_*, resolve_ens) before any write operation.
- send_token and estimate_send accept ENS names (e.g. andrewkimjoseph.celo.eth) directly; use resolve_ens for standalone lookups.
- Always call estimate_send before send_token when possible.
- CELO sends use the GoldToken ERC-20 transfer (Celo token duality — same balance as native CELO). Do not use a separate native-value send for CELO.
- For Mento FX conversions, call get_mento_swap_pairs when the pair is unknown, then get_mento_fx_quote and estimate_mento_fx before execute_mento_fx. Never list Mento pairs from memory.
- For Uniswap swaps, call get_uniswap_swap_pairs when the pair is unknown, then get_uniswap_quote and estimate_uniswap_swap before execute_uniswap_swap. Never list Uniswap pairs from memory. A quote may be uniswap_v3 or uniswap_v4.
- Write tools require CELO_PRIVATE_KEY or SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY in the server environment. Humanness-gated governance/staking execute tools accept optional signer: "celo" | "self_agent" (defaults to CELO when both are set). Invalid env keys are ignored at startup; write tools return config errors until you fix or remove them.
- Humanness: call check_humanness before execute_lock_celo, execute_stake, execute_vote, execute_upvote, execute_dequeue_proposals_if_ready, execute_revoke_governance_votes, execute_revoke_governance_upvote, etc. Passes if Self agent OR GoodDollar whitelist succeeds for the signing address.
- Celo Accounts: get_celo_account_registration before locking CELO. Unregistered addresses must call execute_register_celo_account or prepare_register_celo_account first.
- Governance writes: execute_lock_celo, execute_unlock_celo, execute_relock_celo, execute_withdraw_celo, execute_upvote, execute_vote, execute_dequeue_proposals_if_ready, execute_revoke_governance_votes, execute_revoke_governance_upvote (humanness-gated). Discover: get_queued_proposals (Queue), get_votable_proposals (Referendum), or get_actionable_governance_proposals (both). When get_queued_proposals / get_actionable_governance_proposals report dequeueReady=true, do not upvote proposals with upvoteable=false — call execute_dequeue_proposals_if_ready first (moves them to Approval); vote later in Referendum. Read CGP content with get_proposal_details(proposal_id) before or after acting. Queue flow: get_queued_proposals -> (if dequeueReady: execute_dequeue_proposals_if_ready) else execute_upvote -> get_governance_votes. Referendum flow: get_votable_proposals -> execute_vote -> get_governance_votes. Revoke referendum votes is bulk-only (clears all active referendum votes). Revoke upvote: execute_revoke_governance_upvote. To change a referendum vote, use execute_vote again instead of revoke.
- Staking writes: get_stake_eligibility before execute_stake (checks Election.canReceiveVotes, locked balance, account registration). If canStake is false, read reasons — do not execute (common failure: "Group cannot receive votes" when a group like cLabs is at capacity; pick another group via get_validator_groups). execute_stake, execute_activate_stake, execute_unstake, execute_delegate_power, execute_undelegate_power (humanness-gated).
- Governance delegation (LockedGold voting power, not validator staking): when the user asks who to delegate to, call get_governance_delegates — do not web-scrape Celo Mondo. Pick a delegatee address from results, then get_delegation_info and get_locked_celo_balance, then execute_delegate_power with delegatee and percent (1–100). Any address can receive delegation; the Mondo list is curated off-chain.
- GoodDollar wallet-link: get_gooddollar_face_verification_link (first-time verify this signer wallet; omit callback_url — defaults to https://usecelina.xyz/gooddollar/verify/callback; do not ask the user for a callback URL), execute_connect_gooddollar_identity (link a secondary wallet to an existing verified root), execute_disconnect_gooddollar_identity. Connect requires CELO_PRIVATE_KEY to be the whitelisted GoodDollar root; pass the wallet to link as connected_account. If already verified on wallet A and MCP signer is wallet B, do not face-verify B — switch CELO_PRIVATE_KEY to wallet A and connect B.
- Session wallet (local stdio with CELO_PRIVATE_KEY): call get_wallet_address when you need the signer address as data. For "my" balances and reads, omit address / wallet_address / from on wallet-scoped tools — they default to the configured signer. Never derive addresses from shell commands or read .env. On hosted read-only (no key), pass explicit addresses.
- Dual wallets (CELO_PRIVATE_KEY + SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY): these are two independently keyed wallets. Pass signer: "celo" | "self_agent" on any tool that accepts it (send_token, estimate_send, execute_register_celo_account, governance/staking executes, GoodDollar connect/disconnect) to choose which one acts. Call get_wallet_address with no signer to see both addresses at once (wallets.celo / wallets.self_agent); pass signer explicitly to look up one side.
- Funding a Self agent: a freshly registered Self agent holds 0 CELO and cannot pay gas or lock/stake until funded. Before any self_agent-signed write, check its balance (get_celo_balances with its address), then send_token({ to: <self_agent_address>, token: "CELO", amount, signer: "celo" }) from the main wallet to cover the amount plus gas.
- Signer consistency: once a humanness-gated flow starts on one signer, keep using it for every step — execute_register_celo_account -> execute_lock_celo -> execute_stake / execute_vote must all pass the same signer (the address that passes check_humanness). Do not register with one wallet and lock/stake with the other.
- Known tokens are defined in a single registry: CELO (native), mainnet stablecoins (USDm, EURm, USDC, USDT, USAT, etc.), and GoodDollar.
- Balance tools (registry only — not arbitrary ERC-20 contracts): get_stablecoin_balances for a full stablecoin portfolio scan; get_celo_balances for specific named registry tokens (incl. CELO, WETH); get_token_balance for one registry token (e.g. before send-all/max). Omit address to use the configured signer when CELO_PRIVATE_KEY is set. Balance reads use the literal address only — they do not resolve GoodDollar connected-wallet identity roots.
- Use get_gas_fee_data before estimate_transaction or estimate_send when possible.
- Governance tools (get_governance_proposals, get_queued_proposals, get_votable_proposals, get_actionable_governance_proposals, get_proposal_details, get_governance_votes) fetch on-chain data; set includeMetadata=false for faster list responses. Use get_proposal_details for CGP title and markdown (one proposal at a time). Check dequeueReady / upvoteable on queue tools before execute_upvote.
- Staking tools read Celo validator election data (get_staking_balances, get_validator_groups, get_stake_eligibility, etc.).
- Contract tools: call_contract_function (read) and estimate_contract_gas require caller-supplied ABI JSON. For writes, call estimate_contract_gas then execute_contract_function (requires CELO_PRIVATE_KEY). Optional value is wei as a decimal string. Browser/SDK apps use prepare_contract_function for user wallet signing.
- NFT tools (get_nft_info, get_nft_balance) support ERC-721 and ERC-1155.
- GoodDollar identity: get_gooddollar_identity_link for how a wallet links to IdentityV4 (root, connectedTo, isWhitelistedRoot). get_gooddollar_whitelisting_info and get_gooddollar_ubi_entitlement resolve connected wallets to their verified root (isWhitelisted, isWhitelistedRoot, whitelistedRoot, checkedAddress).
- GoodDollar UBI: use get_gooddollar_ubi_entitlement before claim_daily_gooddollar_ubi (server wallet, CELO_PRIVATE_KEY). One claim per identity per UBI period; connected wallets share the root cooldown.
- GoodDollar reserve (G$ ↔ USDm): use get_gooddollar_reserve_quote for the MentoBroker bonding-curve quote — not Uniswap. For fixed-output questions ("how much G$ to get X USDm?", "swap G$ to receive X USDm"), use amount_side "out" with token_in as spend token (G$ when selling G$ for USDm). Use the same amount_side on estimate_gooddollar_reserve_swap / execute_gooddollar_reserve_swap / prepare_gooddollar_reserve_swap. token_in is always what you spend; balance checks apply to token_in only — never flip tokens or check token_out balance for a sell. Reserve swap tools use the literal signing wallet for balances; they do not resolve identity roots. For stdio MCP with CELO_PRIVATE_KEY, call estimate_gooddollar_reserve_swap before execute_gooddollar_reserve_swap. Browser/SDK apps use prepare_gooddollar_reserve_swap or prepare_swap for user wallet signing. For other G$ pairs (e.g. G$ → USDT), Uniswap remains the AMM fallback.
- Mento FX tools (get_mento_swap_pairs, get_mento_fx_quote, estimate_mento_fx, execute_mento_fx) convert between Mento oracle-priced tokens (USDm, EURm, CELO, etc.). Call get_mento_swap_pairs before listing pairs. They are unavailable when the Mento FX market is closed.
- Uniswap tools (get_uniswap_swap_pairs, get_uniswap_quote, estimate_uniswap_swap, execute_uniswap_swap) quote v3 and v4 and execute the better venue. v4 uses Universal Router + Permit2. v3 uses SwapRouter02. Call get_uniswap_swap_pairs before listing pairs. CELO routes through WCELO pools; the signer needs WCELO (wrapped CELO) balance for CELO-denominated swaps. All on-chain steps include the CELINA attribution tag.
- Aave tools (get_aave_balances, supply_aave, withdraw_aave) on Aave V3 Celo. Supported: USDT, WETH, USDm, USDC, CELO, EURm. get_aave_balances returns formatted (human) and raw (atomic) — quote formatted only. Use get_aave_balances before withdraw; use withdrawMax for full balance. CELO supply requires wrapped CELO (ERC-20), not native CELO.
- Self Agent ID tools (ai.self.xyz on Celo mainnet):
  - Read: verify_self_agent, lookup_self_agent, verify_self_request, get_self_identity. lookup_self_agent returns credentials.ofac_clear (all checks passed) and credentials.ofac_checks[] with list, label, and clear (true = not on that sanctions list).
  - Register: register_self_agent → human scans QR → check_self_registration (returns agent_address immediately, and private_key_hex on success). Defaults: mode wallet-free (omit mode unless linking to a human wallet — then linked + human_address), minimum_age 18, nationality disclosure (ISO code in credentials), and ofac true at registration. check_humanness (Self rail) requires registered agent + age 18+ only — OFAC clearance is not required for governance/staking writes. verify_self_agent still defaults to require_age 18 and require_ofac when inspecting an agent. You can send_token to agent_address as soon as it is known — set SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY and restart the server before using signer: "self_agent" on any write.
  - Lifecycle: refresh_self_proof (only after on-chain proof expiry), deregister_self_agent (poll with check_self_registration)
  - Self session tools (register_self_agent, refresh_self_proof, deregister_self_agent) always return qr_code_url AND deep_link. Always present BOTH links to the human — never omit one.
  - Auth: sign_self_request, authenticated_self_fetch (require SELF_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY). For Self demo/gated APIs use ?network=celo-mainnet (not mainnet), e.g. POST https://app.ai.self.xyz/api/demo/verify?network=celo-mainnet
- Self agent keys are separate from CELO_PRIVATE_KEY. Registration sessions are in-memory (~10 min TTL).
